Descriptive summary, SVD/t-SNE and a transcriptome-wide association scan of
child BMI z-score (WHO) on each transcript cluster, adjusted for ancestry
PCs and blood cell-type proportions.

Source: `EnvBRAN/genexpr.jl`.

```{julia}
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Plots, LinearAlgebra, Statistics, Distributions, CSV, Parquet, TSne
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
phenotype   = DataFrame(read_parquet(datadir("helix", "phenotype.parquet")));
genexpr     = CSV.read(datadir("helix", "genexpr_num.csv"), DataFrame);       # genes × samples, first column `rn`
genexpr_cov = DataFrame(read_parquet(datadir("helix", "genexpr_cov.parquet")));
```

Per-gene summary statistics:

```{julia}
#| eval: false
G = Matrix{Float64}(genexpr[:, 2:end])
MV = DataFrame(gene = string.(genexpr.rn), mean = vec(mean(G; dims = 2)), sd = vec(std(G; dims = 2)),
               q25 = [quantile(r, 0.25) for r in eachrow(G)],
               q50 = [quantile(r, 0.50) for r in eachrow(G)],
               q75 = [quantile(r, 0.75) for r in eachrow(G)])
```

SVD and t-SNE of the samples:

```{julia}
#| eval: false
X = permutedims(G)                       # samples × genes
svd_gene = svd(X);
var_expl = svd_gene.S .^ 2 / sum(svd_gene.S .^ 2)
PCA_gene = svd_gene.U * Diagonal(svd_gene.S)
y_tsne = tsne(X, 2, 50, 1000, 15, pca_init = true, progress = false);
```

Transcriptome-wide association with BMI z-score (`exposure_scan`; the
original script used a hand-written OLS loop):

```{julia}
#| eval: false
genexpr_t = permutedims(genexpr, 1);
rename!(genexpr_t, :rn => :ID);
phenotype.ID = string.(phenotype.ID);
DT = innerjoin(genexpr_cov, phenotype[:, [:ID, :hs_zbmi_who]], on = :ID);
DT = innerjoin(DT, genexpr_t, on = :ID);
DT = DT[completecases(DT), :];

gene_names = string.(genexpr.rn)
covars = [:ethn_PC1, :ethn_PC2, :NK_6, :Bcell_6, :CD4T_6, :CD8T_6, :Gran_6, :Mono_6]
@time ewas_results = exposure_scan(Float64.(DT.hs_zbmi_who), Matrix{Float64}(DT[:, gene_names]),
                                   Matrix{Float64}(DT[:, covars]); names = gene_names)
```

Volcano-style plot:

```{julia}
#| eval: false
ewas2 = ewas_results[abs.(ewas_results.beta) .< 10.0, :]
scatter(ewas2.beta, -log10.(ewas2.p_value), color = ifelse.(ewas2.bonferroni, "aqua", "coral2"),
        size = (400, 300), label = "")
```
